name: nested_key_frame

phase_0.boundary_condition: The outer frame opens first and closes last, so both frames and their AREV work sit inside one boundary; the register is N before the first token and N after the last, which is what closure by construction means.

VINIT.justification: Open the boundary: dimensionality no-op; reads the initial state into the register.

TANCH.justification: Close the boundary: topology no-op; seals the word at its end.

AFWD.justification: Advance: relational work that moves the machine forward one step.

AREV.justification: Reverse: the clearing move; clears the register to EMPTY, and since the register here is N throughout, AREV from N is the identity on N — the work sits inside the frames and leaves nothing exposed.

CLINK.justification: Compose with a return: fidelity-preserving call/return pair.

IMSCRIB.justification: Self-imscription: the identity; criticality no-op, refers the word to itself.

FSPLIT.justification: Open a frame: δ, the fork; from register N it forks to N,N and opens a scope the AREV work cannot escape.

FFUSE.justification: Close a frame: μ, the fuse; folds the frame contents back into the register, N,N → N, restoring the enclosing register exactly.

EVALT.justification: Deposit T: kinetics work that touches the {T} cell.

EVALF.justification: Deposit F: chirality work that touches the {F} cell.

ENGAGR.justification: The Belnap diagonal: stoichiometry work on the {t,f} cell.

IFIX.justification: Fix the result: winding work that sets fixed=True on the final register.

phase_2.failure_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.void_description: N — the empty register; nothing is ever at risk because the AREV clears fire against N and N is already empty.
phase_3.true_description: T — the deposit cell for EVALT work.
phase_3.false_description: F — the deposit cell for EVALF work.
phase_3.both_description: B — the Belnap diagonal, T and F held at once, the dialetheic cell.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The word is the program: ∈<∈<∋<∋ needs no frontend because the glyph sequence IS the compiled form.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The frame pair is the only channel: FSPLIT and FFUSE pass the register between the inner and outer frames.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The register bank is the memory: N/T/F/B are the four cells and the frames are the nesting above them.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: Sequential: tokens execute in order 0..6, outer frame 0→6, inner frame 2→4, no branch ever taken (both arms empty).
phase_5.alfs_store: No unbounded store is needed: the artifact closes entirely within the register and its two frames.

banked_count_check.verdict: nothing was at risk: no clear ever fired against a live register, nothing deposited
